sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count, operation_id, result_status, response_status_code, CASE WHEN api_token_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS token_linked, CASE WHEN activation_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS activation_linked, CASE WHEN created_at = updated_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS single_commit_result, json_extract(response_body, '$.operation_id') AS response_operation_id, json_extract(response_body, '$.status') AS response_status, json_extract(response_body, '$.revoked') AS response_revoked FROM totem_self_revocation_operations WHERE operation_id = '826ead88-92c2-4485-b310-4f84acc85c10' GROUP BY operation_id, result_status, response_status_code, token_linked, activation_linked, single_commit_result, response_operation_id, response_status, response_revoked
